title: Fovea Tour Content Bundle
description: Per-deployment content for Fovea's ten built-in guided tours. Drop this file at /tour-content.json in the annotation-tool's public/ directory (or anywhere the frontend can fetch it from /tour-content.json). The loader reads it at boot, resolves each videoFilename to the videoId Fovea computes via md5(filename)[0:16], and hands the result to TourProvider. Editing this file is the entire admin-tailoring surface. no rebuild, no code edits required.

firstAnnotation.description: Tour 1: First annotation in 90 seconds. the on-ramp.

personaName.description: Persona the visitor adopts for their first annotation.

videoFilename.description: Filename in STORAGE_PATH the visitor lands on. Pick a clip where the entityType is plainly visible.

ontologyAuthoring.description: Tour 2: visitor builds one type at each of the four ontology layers.

wikidataAugmentation.description: Tour 3: visitor searches Wikidata for a concept and imports it as a type.

searchTerm.description: Search term the visitor types. pick one that returns a real Wikidata QID + makes sense for this deployment's domain.

eventsRolesClaims.description: Tour 4: visitor boxes two actors, declares an event between them, assigns roles, watches Fovea derive a claim.

eventType.description: Event the visitor declares between the two actors.

derivedClaimText.description: Sentence the engine illustrates as the structured claim Fovea derived.

videoFilename.description: MUST depict the event between the two actors. otherwise the narration's instructions don't map to anything on screen.

worldLayer.description: Tour 5: visitor models a specific place + time + collection.

entityType.description: Type the entity is an instance of. e.g. Stadium.

videoFilename.description: Clip that visibly depicts the entity being modeled.
Pick a clip with a CLEAR MOVING SUBJECT. the tracker is boring on static shots.

summariesAndClaims.description: Tour 7: visitor writes a summary + extracts claims from it.

summaryText.description: Summary text the visitor types into the editor.

videoFilename.description: Must be a clip the summaryText actually describes.

importExport.description: Tour 10: upload a bundle through the import dialog.

importBundlePath.description: Path/URL the test or visitor uploads at step 1.

name.description: Name of the type the visitor types into the editor.

gloss.description: Human-readable definition that lands in the gloss field.
